sculpt_basket_berries.notes: Sculpted berry basket (wide withy stake-and-strand bowl, thick rim, bentwood bail with straw bindings, berries heaped, leaves). Vertex colours on every LOD, no textures: batched, burnable prop. Families straw / fruit / leaf (as prop_basket_berries).
